## What changed

- Logs now record lifecycle events only; edits no longer appear in them (#65)
- Use the new `kmctl decision accept` and `kmctl check --no-drafts` commands, and the action now blocks drafts at review (#66)

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.16.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.16.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0
